description.p: TuxBlox runs the official, unmodified Windows Roblox client on Linux, using its own compatibility layer built specifically for Roblox.
Features:

ul.li: Roblox Studio with working docking, web views and sign-in
Sessions view with live memory use and a log viewer for every session
Install the latest, previous, or a specific Roblox version
FastFlags editor
Option to choose the graphics API and the graphics card
Discord Rich Presence and Bloxstrap API support
Show where the game or Team Create server you joined is located

description.p: This is a very big stable release for TuxBlox with some of the biggest changes TuxBlox has ever seen.
Flags system

We have introduced a new system to TuxBlox, and it's called flags, it is a set of internal TuxBlox settings that are far more advanced than the normal settings, it allows you to internally change some things without having to rebuild or get a different version of TuxBlox.

Our servers can also change some of your flags, however your on-disk flags override the server's flags, we only change flags on our side if we want to lock a feature until a certain point, or if we want to fix issues without releasing a new version of TuxBlox.
More documentation on TuxBlox's flags feature can be found here: https://tuxblox.net/docs/advanced/tuxblox-flags
We're introducing 3 new installation options:
1. GitHub releases
TuxBlox is now available from GitHub releases. Every release is published there with all its files and changelogs. Installing works exactly the same either way, so use whichever you prefer.
https://github.com/cherrypath0/tuxblox/releases
2. Flatpak Installation
TuxBlox is now available as a Flatpak! You can install the Flatpak locally.
Some features in Flatpak had to deliberately be disabled because of its sandbox, and since Flatpak handles updates itself, TuxBlox's auto-updater is disabled on Flatpak builds.

3. AppImage installers

We now distribute the TuxBlox installer as an AppImage! Obtaining it is very easy, go to either the website or the GitHub releases, then obtain the TuxBloxInstaller.AppImage file. Make sure that the AppImage has permissions to run on your system:

p.code: cd ~/Downloads # or whatever folder you have downloaded it to

This release didn't only affect how you install TuxBlox, but also how you build TuxBlox.
An easier way to build TuxBlox
Building TuxBlox used to be complicated: a build.sh script, assets fetched online on every build, and a full rebuild every time. All of that is gone, replaced by simple make commands.

ul.li: Offline builds. Sources are downloaded once, checked against recorded checksums, and reused. The build itself runs with no network access.
Faster rebuilds. Only what changed gets rebuilt. Building the launcher a second time takes about two seconds.
Reproducible. Building the same source twice now produces the same download.

Runtime 3.11.1

Added the flag tbxFlagTranslateWindowsShortcuts, on by default, which translates Roblox's Windows-formatted desktop shortcuts to Linux desktop shortcuts
Added session identifiers for each Roblox instance
Changed the way Roblox renders pixels to match Windows
Changed the check that Roblox's files are genuine to run as Roblox starts, rather than in the launcher beforehand
Changed the look of the message dialogs
Fixed a crash corrupting the entire virtual drive and requiring a reset
Fixed issues with message dialogs
Fixed closing one instance of Roblox waiting for the others to close
Fixed closing one instance of Roblox automatically focusing to the other ones
Fixed focus not working whenever a file manager is opened by Roblox
Fixed menus and title bars incorrectly doubling in size at higher desktop scales
Fixed Roblox freezing forever whenever it raises a dialog
Fixed the mouse lock sometimes not locking properly whenever focusing back to Roblox
Fixed the integrated file manager appearing a minute after the native file manager appears
Fixed TuxBlox refusing to launch some official Roblox builds that were signed differently
Fixed new windows randomly stealing focus
Fixed Roblox being unable to flash in the taskbar
Fixed Studio camera issues on GNOME XWayland
Fixed Studio freezing when a built-in web panel stopped loading
Fixed Studio freezing when opening a file picker
Fixed files saved into nested directories ending up in the wrong place
Fixed file pickers opening on internal paths instead of the real folders
Fixed Roblox failing to clear its cache
Renamed TuxBlox's server process to "tuxblox-server"
Removed two uninformative session log lines
Removed uninformative window-related web engine logs
